## Example 3.11 · Compare the histograms {#l2-example-3-11 .compact .histogram-quiz}

```{=html}
<div class="paired-charts"><div><h3>X</h3><div data-module="chart" data-set="histX" data-modes="frequency" data-static="true"></div></div><div><h3>Y</h3><div data-module="chart" data-set="histY" data-modes="frequency" data-static="true"></div></div></div>
```

```{=html}
<div data-module="quiz" data-correct="B" class="quiz">
<p class="hinge-question">The sets of data X and Y are displayed in the histograms. Which statement is true?</p>
<div class="choices"><button class="choice" data-answer="A" aria-pressed="false"><b>A</b><span>X has a larger mode and has a larger range.</span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="B" aria-pressed="false"><b>B</b><span>X has a larger mode and the ranges are the same.</span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="C" aria-pressed="false"><b>C</b><span>The modes are the same and Y has a larger range.</span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="D" aria-pressed="false"><b>D</b><span>The modes are the same and the ranges are the same.</span></button></div>
<div class="hinge-bottom"><p>Choose an answer and justify it before revealing.</p><button class="reveal-answer primary">Reveal answer</button><button class="reset-question">Reset</button></div>
<div class="hinge-explanation" hidden>B. Mode(X) = 9 and mode(Y) = 8. Range(X) = 9 − 3 = 6; range(Y) = 11 − 5 = 6.</div>
</div>
```

::: notes
Source: HSC Standard Mathematics2011Q11, as reproduced in the supplied booklet p47. Histograms redrawn from the supplied figure: X scores3–9 frequencies4,4,3,2,3,4,5; Y scores5–11 frequencies2,3,4,5,4,3,2. The original datasets and answer options are preserved. Note that shifting horizontal position alone does not change the range.
:::
